description:
Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Snow White while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Snow White
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles
name: Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
intro: Experience Snow White story through logic puzzles!
